resources.string: Stop
Try Again
You’re Offline
This phone isn’t connected to the internet. Pages open once it is.
Can’t Reach %1$s
Pages open through %1$s, and it isn’t answering. Make sure it’s awake and Happy is running there.
Can’t Open This Page
Pages open through a computer running Happy Agent, and there’s no connection to open this one through.
Can’t Find the Server
%1$s couldn’t find “%2$s”. Check the address.
%1$s couldn’t find the server. Check the address.
Server Isn’t Responding
The server on your computer at “%1$s” isn’t responding. Make sure it’s running, then try again.
The server on your computer isn’t responding. Make sure it’s running, then try again.
Page Took Too Long
“%1$s” didn’t answer in time.
The server didn’t answer in time.
Can’t Open Securely
A secure connection to “%1$s” couldn’t be made.
A secure connection to the server couldn’t be made.
Android opens plain http:// pages only from localhost. Open “%1$s” with https:// instead.
Android opens plain http:// pages only from localhost. Use an https:// address instead.
Page Error %1$d
The server answered “%1$s” with nothing to show.
The server answered with an error and nothing to show.
This Page Stopped Working
A problem kept happening while it loaded. Try opening it again.
Can’t Open This Link
No app on this phone opens “%1$s:” links.
No app on this phone opens this link.
